title: FSVL: Taxonomic Fast-Slow Vision-to-Language Collaborative Framework for Interpretable Confusable Fish Species Identification and Knowledge Generation in the Middle Yangtze River
abstract: arXiv:2610.31880v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The Yangtze River Basin is a critical region for freshwater biodiversity conservation. The implementation of the Yangtze River Ten-Year Fishing Ban has increased the importance of effective aquatic biodiversity monitoring and species-level identification. However, fine-grained identification of closely related freshwater fish species remains challenging due to subtle morphological differences. Existing deep learning methods often struggle to balance classification accuracy and inference efficiency, while LLMs may generate unsupported information when producing specialized biological knowledge. To address these challenges, this study proposes FSVL, a fast-slow dual-pathway framework integrating visual recognition with LLM-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). translated_title: FSVL：面向长江中游易混淆鱼类可解释识别与知识生成的分类学快-慢视觉-语言协同框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.31880v1 公告类型：交叉。摘要：长江流域是淡水生物多样性保护的关键区域。长江“十年禁渔”政策的实施使得有效的水生生物多样性监测和物种级鉴定变得更加重要。然而，由于形态差异细微，对近缘淡水鱼种进行细粒度识别仍然具有挑战性。现有的深度学习方法往往难以在分类准确率和推理效率之间取得平衡，而大语言模型（LLM）在生成专业生物学知识时可能产生缺乏依据的信息。为应对这些挑战，本研究提出了FSVL，一个融合视觉识别与基于大语言模型的检索增强生成（RAG）的快-慢双通路框架。轻量级的ResNet50快速通路对长江中游流域的51种鱼类进行初步分类，并将预定义的易混淆类群进行路由分流……
tldr: 该论文提出FSVL快-慢双通路框架，利用轻量级ResNet50快速通路结合基于大语言模型的检索增强生成（RAG）慢速通路，在保证推理效率的同时实现对长江中游易混淆鱼类的可解释细粒度识别和可靠生物学知识生成。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FSVL, a fast-slow dual-pathway framework that combines a lightweight ResNet50 fast path with LLM-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation, achieving interpretable fine-grained identification of confusable fish species and reliable biological knowledge generation in the Middle Yangtze River.
